name: @drawpane/engine
description: The render engine (decision 0040): a Rust render graph drawn by Vello on WebGPU in the browser and on the CPU in Workers, compiled to WebAssembly, with its display list's wire format.

scripts.test:rust: cd rust && mise exec -- cargo test
scripts.fuzz: cd rust && FUZZ_CASES=$(( ${FUZZ_RUNS:-2000} / 10 )) FUZZ_SEED=${FUZZ_SEED:-random} mise exec -- cargo test --release --test fuzz
